name: Shiranui Kazuki
source:
Kazuki represents the Aries. He is the president of the student council. He is gifted with the power of foresight, although this ability does not allow him to see everything.  He is a third year (apparently he repeated a year, together with Shirogane).

[spoiler]He blames himself for the death of his parents because of his lack of understanding his power, and he hates it.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starry_Sky#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
